title: My first ever game is my dream DBZ racer
author: Fine-Combination5170
selftext:
Its a fast paced aggressive racer with multiple game modes.

The link is [https://wunnam-ak.itch.io/z-riders](https://wunnam-ak.itch.io/z-riders) if you wanna try it, i would love feedback

I went for the ps1 look for style what do yall think?

comments.author: Elegant_Tech
comments.body: My instant feedback would be you want PS1 graphics you should have PS1 quality UI. The UI and game should go together in fidelity and style. The game and UI just clash way to much for me.

replies.author: Typical_Sky8316
replies.body: Nice catch, i didn't think about it at first but now that you mention it, it would be much better. But it looks amazing anyways

replies.author: Fine-Combination5170
replies.body: Yeah that's true but i had to decide between that or harder to read UI

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Fine-Combination5170 please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: Jayston1994
comments.body: Omfg what a cool idea. This is sick!!!

comments.author: hello-xworld
comments.body:
Honestly this is a very cool idea. I don’t think it’s quite production ready yet, still a lot of polishing and iterating required, but I can tell you put in time and effort to make something fun and bring your vision to reality.

Keep it up! Looks fun and chaotic

comments.author: newgenesisscion
comments.body:
Didn't know I needed this. 

With some polish it would be great. So many potential tracks, Snake Way, Names, etc.

comments.author: mile-high-guy
comments.body: This is cool, but why have a racing type track? don't they fly?

comments.author: pirondi
comments.body: wow that is such a great concept.

comments.author: khodakk
comments.body:
i like that your idea is original. and as a racer seems fun enough and could be better with polish. 

but also feel like needs more DB in the formula. like falling off the track doesn’t make sense to me from a DBZ pov. maybe you can be blasted off but you should still be able to recover and fly back? maybe if the tracks have boosts or if you fly slightly slower off track then it leaves players with the full range to fly where they want but to actually out pace you incentivize the players to fight for the track. 

curious how you’d integrate going SS and other transformations.
